<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

def find_blue_block(lines):
    blue_cells = []
    for r in range(17, 25):
        for c in range(17, 45):
            if lines[r][c] == 'b':
                blue_cells.append((r, c))
    if blue_cells:
        rows = [r for r,c in blue_cells]
        cols = [c for r,c in blue_cells]
        return (min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols), len(blue_cells))
    return None

def find_track(lines):
    track_cells = []
    for r in range(17, 25):
        for c in range(17, 45):
            if lines[r][c] == 'g':
                track_cells.append((r, c))
    return track_cells

bb = find_blue_block(ascii_lines)
print(f"Blue block: {bb}")

# Map the track shape
track = find_track(ascii_lines)
print(f"Track cells count: {len(track)}")
# Print track rows
for r in range(17, 25):
    row_cells = [c for rr, c in track if rr == r]
    if row_cells:
        print(f"Row {r}: cols {min(row_cells)}-{max(row_cells)}, count={len(row_cells)}")

# Try UP to get back to top of track
result = action(['UP'])
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
bb = find_blue_block(ascii_lines)
print(f"UP: blue={bb}")

# Now try LEFT multiple times to reach vertical section
for i in range(10):
    result = action(['LEFT'])
    ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    bb = find_blue_block(ascii_lines)
    print(f"LEFT {i+1}: blue={bb}, done={last_action_result.get('done')}")
    if last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
